description: Keyword coverage parity cases for retrieval_stats (Codeinwp/hyve#330), shared with the Hyve Connect platform: both implementations must produce the same term_count, matched, coverage and matching_hits for every case. term_count is the number of diagnostic patterns built from the query's content words: every word of three or more characters, with no cap, minus common English words that carry no topic (the index's stopwords, pronouns, auxiliaries and question scaffolding such as 'tell' and 'know'); matched is the most patterns one candidate's title + ' ' + content matches (0 with no candidates); coverage is matched / term_count rounded to 4 places, null when term_count is 0; matching_hits is how many candidates match at least one pattern. In retrieval_stats a term_count of 0 is recorded as null for all four fields. Accents fold by WordPress's default (en_US) rules whatever the site's locale, after NFC normalization (WordPress only normalizes when PHP's intl normalizer is available; without it, decomposed non-Latin marks stay decomposed in Lite).
